_about: Region assignments (x1) for the drop objects o1/o2/d1/d2 left out: trees (Obj_Tree_A_01/A_02, Obj_Tree_Tutorial_A_01, Obj_Gerudo_PalmTree_A_01), the Hyrule Field bushes (Land_kokiri_Plant_A_02_DropFixed_03), always-respawn grass and pots (*_Respawn), silver rocks (Obj_LiftRock_B_01) and the Obj_LiftRock_A_02/C_01/C_05 rocks of drop_objects.csv; one entry per hash. Same format and standard as drops_regions_o1/o2/d1/d2: region = exact OoTR region where Link stands to break/use the object; rule = extra OoTR rule to reach it inside that region (no age, and not the object's own break requirement: rolling, cutting, Silver/Golden Gauntlets are added by category). Method: positions from drop_objects.csv against the nearest objects already assigned in o1/o2/d1/d2 (same level and room), landmarks from the level files (actors within ~20 units: grotto holes, doors, NPCs, Gold Skulltulas), drop_map / gs_positions (GS trees), the d1/d2 room maps. low = junk only (the DreamWorld boss-rush copies, which have no OoTR region).
